title: Wo Askari Ka Pisar Hai
body:
WO ASKARI KA PISAR HAI JO ANE WALA HAI
SABHI KO JAAM WILA KA PILA NE WALA HAI
CHALO CHALE KE ABHI ASKARI KE DAR PAI SABHI
KHUDA WAHA ABHI QISMAT BANANE WALA HAI
ABHI ZULAIKHA BHI APNE IRADE BADLENGI
ABHI WOH RUK SE JO PARDA UTHA NE WALA HAI
MAI KARHA HU YAHAN IBNE MURTAZA KI SANA
KYA FATIMA KO KOI YE BATANE WALA HAI
SUNA HAI MUSAO AHMED NE RAB KA LEHGA MAGAR
HUME TOH YUSUF E ZEHRA SUNANE WALA HAI
WOH JISNE CHEEN K BHAGE FIDAK KO KHAYA THA
WOH TEGH MEHDI SE AB ZARB KHANE WALA HAI
HAI JITNA SOONA ABHI SOO NABI K BAZU MAI
WOH AAKE DEKH NA KAISE JAGANE WALA HAI
WOH AAKE DEKH NA MURGA BANANE WALA HAI
NAMAZ ROZE NAHI KHUMS AUR ZAKAT NAHI
AMAAL KYA YE SABHI TU DIKHANE WALA HAI
BAQIYATULLAH SE SABIT YE SAAF HOTA HAI
KOI TOH HAI JO YE DUNIYA CHALANE WALA HAI
NIDA YE KAZIM O SADIQ MALAK KI AATI HAI
TUMHARA SHAER YE JANNAT MAI JAANE WALA HAI
